evaluations.evidence: PP-041: As a participant, I want to change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed, so that I can change my mind.
evaluations.rationale: PP-034 and PP-041 both express the requirement to allow participants to change their estimate before the draw is completed, with only minor wording differences.

evaluations.evidence: PP-034: As a participant, I want to be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown, so that I can change my mind based on information I hear.
